resources.string: Optional: install official Shizuku, or switch to Built-in
Start built-in service via Wireless debugging (each reboot)
Switch to Built-in in Settings, or grant Root

This engine needs the official Shizuku APK.

Prefer one APK? Switch Killer Engine to «Built-in (ADB)» in Settings — no Shizuku required.

Or download Shizuku, start it via Wireless debugging, then authorize.

Built-in mode (no official Shizuku APK).

1. Turn on Wireless debugging (button below opens that screen).
2. First time only: in system settings tap «Pair device with pairing code», then enter the 6-digit code here (the app cannot read the code for you).
3. Tap Start service — the app discovers adbd, launches its private server, and connects.
4. After reboot: Start again (pairing is remembered; wireless debugging may need toggling once).

After the first success, the app can auto-enable Wireless debugging when the system allows.
